# Money coming back from a supplier, recorded against two expense splits.
#
# `Assets:Due From Director USD` +100.00 against `Expenses:Supplies:USD`
# −60.00 and −40.00. The signs are the opposite of a payment: the director is
# owed less, and the cost is being taken off.
#
# A bill payment reduces the payable, so its split on the payable is
# positive. These two are negative. Applying them would put −100.00 into the
# bill's lot beside the posting's own −100.00.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction of three splits, none in a
# lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies:USD
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Due From Director USD
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-03-08 * "Supplier refunded the director"
	guid: "4c5d6e7f8a9b0cddeeff00112233aabb"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Due From Director USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "5d6e7f8a9b0cddeeff00112233aabb4c"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Expenses:Supplies:USD -60.00 USD
		guid: "6e7f8a9b0cddeeff00112233aabb4c5d"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Expenses:Supplies:USD -40.00 USD
		guid: "7f8a9b0cddeeff00112233aabb4c5d6e"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
